import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w=params[0]
    s=np.sin(w*t); c=np.cos(w*t)
    return (params[1]+params[2]*t+params[3]*t**2+params[4]*x+params[5]*v
            +params[6]*v*s+params[7]*v*c+params[8]*s+params[9]*c)
